  function run(){
    // اختار أقرب قسم فيه عنوان الأداة
    const title = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2"))
      .find(el => el.innerText.includes("Sawan Kids Story"));

    if(!title) return;

    const hero = title.closest("section,div");
    if(!hero || hero.dataset.heroDone) return;
    hero.dataset.heroDone = "true";

    hero.style.position = "relative";
    hero.style.overflow = "hidden";
    hero.style.borderRadius = "18px";
    hero.style.minHeight = "260px";

    // صورة حقيقية

    img.src =
      "https://png.pngtree.com/thumb_back/fh260/background/20241231/pngtree-amusement-park-image_16505595.jpg";
    img.alt = "Kids reading story";
    img.style.position = "absolute";
    img.style.inset = "0";
    img.style.width = "100%";
    img.style.height = "100%";
    img.style.objectFit = "cover";
    img.style.zIndex = "0";

    // طبقة تغميق
    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.style.position = "absolute";
    overlay.style.inset = "0";
    overlay.style.background =

    overlay.style.zIndex = "1";

      el.style.position = "relative";
      el.style.zIndex = "2";
    });

    hero.prepend(overlay);
    hero.prepend(img);
  }

  run();
  new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true
  });

})();
